please suggest one feature per issue. you can write in english or russian.

### how to fill out this template

1. in the checklist below, replace `- [ ]` with `- [x]` for each statement that is true. leave other boxes unchecked.
2. replace the prompts under each heading with your answers. explain what the feature would do and why you need it.
3. write "not applicable" or remove optional sections you do not need.
4. give the issue a short title that describes the feature, then submit it.

### checklist

- [ ] i am suggesting a feature or improvement, not reporting a bug
- [ ] i have searched [existing issues](https://github.com/kittenello/Donutgram/issues) for similar suggestions
- [ ] i have checked whether this feature already exists in the latest available donutgram version

### problem or use case

describe what you want to accomplish and what is missing or inconvenient today.

### proposed feature

describe how the feature should work, where it should appear, and what the user should be able to do.

### alternatives (optional)

describe any workarounds or other solutions you have considered.

### examples or mockups (optional)

attach screenshots, sketches, or links that help explain the idea. hide personal information.

### additional context (optional)

add any relevant details, such as your donutgram version, device model, or ios / ipados version if the idea depends on them.
